pvObligation.name: PV obligation in existing buildings
pvObligation.description: Assists in determining the roof area that must be covered with PV when significant roof renovations are carried out.

wizard.introduction: This application is intended to assist in calculating the roof area that must be covered with photovoltaics (PV) when "major roof renovations" are carried out. The PDF report that you can create at the end is for your personal records and also serves as proof in the event of a random check by the responsible authority.
wizard.introductionInfoPvApp: However, please read the information about this application at the following link:
wizard.introductionInfoPvAppLink: Notes on using the tool - hamburg.de
wizard.introductionInfoPvObligation: General information on the PV obligation can be found here:

component.introduction: In this step, select the desired building by clicking on it on the map. This will determine the gross roof area.
component.introductionHint: Note: The roof areas of the selected building have been recorded automatically.
component.tableCellGrossAreaLabel: The gross roof area of the selected building is:
component.tooSmallAreaText: There is no PV obligation (minimum size 50 m²).

confirmModal.contentIntro: You have already selected a roof surface. If you leave the selected roof surface, all previously entered data will be lost.
confirmModal.contentQuestion: Do you really want to leave the roof surface and choose a different one?

component.missingStepGrossAreaError: Please first select your roof in the step "Gross roof area".
component.missingStepGrossAreaMessage: Afterwards, the initial net roof area will be displayed here, and you can, if necessary, draw areas that should additionally be excluded.
component.drawingIsNotCompletedError: The drawing is not yet complete. Please select Save or Cancel before proceeding to the next step.
component.introduction: Add areas here that are relevant for calculating the net roof area. Relevant areas include existing skylights, existing roof structures, other necessary existing roof uses, and north-facing roof areas with a slope of over 10 degrees, provided these areas have not already been automatically recorded.
component.introductionHint: Note: Shading is only recorded in the next step.
component.substractFromNetArea: The drawn areas are additionally subtracted from the gross roof area.
component.substractFromNetAreaLabel: The net roof area of the building is:
component.substractFromNetAreaValueLabel: The net roof area of the building minus {{squareMeters}} m² is:
component.minPvRequirement: According to the Hamburg Climate Protection Act, you must cover at least 30% of the net roof area with PV.
component.minPvRequirementLabel: You must cover at least the following area with PV:

component.missingStepGrossAreaError: Please first select your roof in the step "Gross roof area".
component.missingStepGrossAreaMessage: Afterwards, you can, if necessary, draw areas here that you want to designate as restricted areas.
component.introduction: If roof areas cannot be used for PV, the PV obligation does not apply to the extent that these areas limit the obligation. Add "restricted areas" here that do not have to be covered with PV.
component.tableCellRestrictedAreasSumLabel: The sum of the restricted areas is:
component.tableCellPvAreaRequirementLabel: The area that must still be covered with PV is:
component.tableCellPvAreaRequirementReducedLabel: The area that must be covered with PV is reduced from {{squareMeters}} m² to

component.introduction: Enter the name(s) of the owner(s) of the building here.
You have the option to add your own explanations here.
Below you can generate a PDF report containing the information you provided. You can keep this as proof for your records.
component.introductionHint: Note: The data you provide is only used to create the PDF report. No data is stored or transmitted to the responsible authority.
component.generalError: Error: Not all required fields are filled in. Please complete the missing information to generate the report.

restrictionList.formHeaderCreateDescription: Use the drawing tool below to mark a relevant area on your roof and add a note. After saving, you can record more areas or edit them in the list.
restrictionList.numberExplaination: The identifier ({{ id }}) corresponds to the area marked on the map with the same ID.

helpFormDrawCreate.text: To add a new relevant area, draw it directly on your roof area in the map. When drawing a polygon, place the desired corner points one after another and finish the input with a double click.

helpFormDrawModify.text: You can modify the drawings you created directly on the map using the mouse.

restrictionList.missingAreaText: Please draw the area to be excluded from the net roof area.

report.title: PV Obligation
report.description: Calculation of the PV area for existing buildings in the event of significant roof renovations within the framework of the PV obligation according to §16 HmbKliSchG.

areas.restrictedAreas: These areas are designated as restricted areas where, according to HmbKliSchG and PVUmsVO, no photovoltaic systems are mandatory.
